zh: 路人只是站在一旁看着，没人上前帮忙。
en: Passers-by just {looked on|watched|stood by} and nobody helped.

zh: 有些人在网上故意挑起矛盾。
en: Some people online are deliberately {stirring up|causing|starting} trouble.

zh: 抗议现场的紧张情绪最终爆发了。
en: Tensions finally {boiled over|erupted|flared up} at the protest.

zh: 抗议者要求提高工资。
en: Protesters are {calling for|demanding|asking for|pushing for} better pay.

zh: 数千人来参加了抗议活动。
en: Thousands of people {turned out|came out|showed up|came} for the protest.

zh: 那座老教堂去年被烧毁了。
en: The old church {burned down|burnt down} last year.

zh: 洪水过后他们调来了军队帮忙。
en: They {called in|brought in|sent in} the army to help after the floods.

zh: 那起丑闻让政府倒台了。
en: The scandal {brought down|toppled} the government.

zh: 暴风雨来临前，顾客把面包货架都抢空了。
en: Shoppers {cleaned out|emptied|stripped} the bread shelves before the storm.

zh: 部长回击了批评者。
en: The minister {hit back at|responded to} his critics.

zh: 他因为抢劫被关了五年。
en: He was {locked up|jailed|imprisoned|put away} for five years for robbery.

zh: 我们街角那家小卖部去年关门了。
en: The dairy on our corner {shut down|closed down|closed} last year.

zh: 新法律带来了很大的变化。
en: The new law has {brought about|caused|led to|created|resulted in} big changes.

zh: 警察让人群往后退。
en: The police told the crowd to {keep back|stay back|stand back|move back}.

zh: 他们故意拖延谈判。
en: They're deliberately {dragging out|prolonging|stringing out|spinning out} the negotiations.

zh: 抗议活动一个小时后就渐渐平息了。
en: The protest {fizzled out|petered out|died down} after an hour.

zh: 暴风雨过后，惠灵顿一半的地方都停电了。
en: Half of Wellington was {blacked out} after the storm.

zh: 政府强行通过了这项新法律。
en: The government {pushed through|forced through|rushed through|rammed through} the new law.

zh: 警方说昨晚有一伙年轻人在酒吧外面把一个男人打了。
en: Police say a group of teens {beat up|attacked|assaulted|bashed} a man outside a bar last night.

zh: 警方正在严厉打击酒驾。
en: Police are {cracking down on|clamping down on|getting tough on} drink-driving.

zh: 抗议活动蔓延到了附近的街道。
en: The protest {spilled over|spilt over|spread} into nearby streets.

zh: 有人向警方通风报信，说了那辆被偷的车的事。
en: Someone {tipped off|alerted|warned|told|informed} the police about the stolen car.

zh: 护士们因为工资问题罢工了。
en: Nurses {walked out|went on strike} over pay.

zh: 消防员很快就把火扑灭了。
en: Firefighters quickly {put out|extinguished} the fire.

zh: 那个小镇被洪水困住了，与外界隔绝。
en: The town was {cut off|isolated} by the floods.

zh: 搜救人员分散开来搜索灌木丛。
en: The search team {spread out|fanned out|split up} to search the bush.

zh: 公众舆论转而反对政府。
en: Public opinion {turned against} the government.

zh: 公司试图掩盖这次数据泄露。
en: The company tried to {hush up|cover up} the data leak.

zh: 那名记者开始深挖他的财务状况。
en: The reporter has started {digging into|looking into|investigating|delving into} his finances.

zh: 她要竞选市长。
en: She's {standing for|running for} mayor.

zh: 车库里的一个煤气罐爆炸了。
en: A gas bottle {blew up|exploded|went off} in the garage.

zh: 一周后风波就平息了。
en: The fuss {died down|blew over|settled down|faded} after a week.

zh: 法官驳回了这个案子。
en: The judge {threw out|dismissed|rejected} the case.

zh: 超市的一次性塑料袋已经逐步被淘汰了。
en: Single-use plastic bags have been {phased out} at supermarkets.

zh: 她公开站出来反对这项新政策。
en: She {spoke out against|campaigned against|protested against} the new policy.

zh: 昨晚有两名囚犯越狱了。
en: Two prisoners {broke out} of jail last night.

zh: 海啸警报已经解除了。
en: The tsunami warning has been {stood down|lifted|cancelled|canceled}.

zh: 警方已经停止了搜寻。
en: Police have {called off|stopped|ended|abandoned} the search.

zh: 选举前的那几周，到处都是广告。
en: In the weeks {leading up to|before} the election, there were ads everywhere.

zh: 政府已经把新规定弱化了不少。
en: The government has {watered down|weakened|softened|diluted} the new rules.

zh: 店主奋起反抗，劫匪跑了。
en: The shop owner {fought back} and the robber ran off.

zh: 市长年底将会卸任。
en: The mayor is {stepping down|standing down|resigning|retiring} at the end of the year.

zh: 他们正在拆掉那座旧电影院，要盖公寓。
en: They're {pulling down|knocking down|tearing down|demolishing} the old cinema to build apartments.

zh: 警察赶到之前小偷就跑掉了。
en: The thief {got away|escaped|ran off} before the police arrived.

zh: 疫情期间，政府出钱救了那家航空公司。
en: The government {bailed out|rescued|saved} the airline during the pandemic.

zh: 昨晚工会和公司之间的谈判破裂了。
en: Talks between the union and the company {broke down|collapsed|failed|fell through} last night.

zh: 昨晚有人撬了我的车。
en: Someone {broke into} my car last night.

zh: 政府决心杜绝校园霸凌。
en: The government wants to {stamp out|wipe out|put an end to|eliminate|end} bullying in schools.

zh: 令人惊讶的是，司机毫发无伤地走了出来。
en: Amazingly, the driver {walked away} without a scratch.

zh: 人们终于开始意识到这些风险了。
en: People are finally {waking up to|realising|realizing|becoming aware of} the risks.

zh: 他们打算拆掉那座老图书馆。
en: They're going to {tear down|knock down|pull down|demolish} the old library.

zh: 这份报告对真正的问题一笔带过。
en: The report {glosses over|skims over|skips over} the real problems.

zh: 市政府正在推行新的垃圾回收制度。
en: The council is {bringing in|introducing|rolling out} a new recycling system.

zh: 洪水过后，政府派军队去帮忙。
en: The government {sent in|deployed|sent} the army to help after the floods.

zh: 我每天早上看新闻了解时事。
en: I read the news every morning to {keep up with|keep up to date with|stay up to date with} what's happening.

zh: 警方呼吁目击者出面提供线索。
en: Police are asking witnesses to {come forward|step forward}.

zh: 面对记者的提问，她巧妙地一一挡了回去。
en: She {fended off|deflected|dodged|parried} questions from reporters.

zh: 市政府正在收紧海滩上遛狗的规定。
en: The council is {tightening up|tightening} the rules on dogs at the beach.

zh: 政府淡化了问题的严重性。
en: The government {played down|downplayed|minimised|minimized} how serious the problem was.

zh: 那家公司试图掩盖这个错误。
en: The company tried to {cover up|hide|hush up|conceal} the mistake.

zh: 昨晚两名男子持械抢劫了一家加油站。
en: Two men {held up|robbed} a petrol station last night.
